description: Single, wages and interest, standard deduction
Head of household uses the joint 2026 schedule; gains taxed as ordinary income; AGI over $100,000 so no Oklahoma child credit
working: Form 511: federal AGI = 95,000 + 15,000 = 110,000 (Oklahoma capital gain deduction applies only to Oklahoma-sourced property, none here). Standard deduction (head of household) 9,350. Exemptions: self + 1 dependent = 2 x 1,000 = 2,000. Taxable = 110,000 - 9,350 - 2,000 = 98,650. 2026 schedule for married filing jointly and heads of household (2355(D)(2)): 0% on first 7,500 = 0; 2.5% on next 2,300 = 57.50; 3.5% on next 4,600 = 161.00; 4.5% on remainder 98,650 - 14,400 = 84,250 -> 3,791.25. Tax = 4,009.75. Child tax credit: federal AGI 110,000 > 100,000, none. (Federal HoH: taxable 110,000 - 24,150 = 85,850; ordinary 70,850: 1,770 + 12% x 49,750 = 5,970 + 22% x 3,400 = 748 -> 8,488; gains 15% x 15,000 = 2,250; regular tax 10,738 less child tax credit 2,200 = 8,538.)
